topic: Conversion of base 10 numerals to binary numbers
objectives: Convert base 10 numerals to binary numbers
teacher_activities: Uses bundles or piles to demonstrate conversion from base 10 to base two (e.g. 3 represents 1 bundle of two and 1 unit, i.e. 3₁₀ = 11₂)
student_activities: Use bundles in twos and units to repeat teacher's demonstration for numbers 1–10
tlm: Charts, counters such as match sticks, broom sticks, bottle tops
eval_guide: Convert given base 10 numbers to base two
Prepare a conversion chart of numbers 1–10 from base 10 to base 2
